\subsection*{2026-09-09 (CLXII): Source fields, full lattice dynamics and Clock/E8 bridge consolidated}
The post-Round~27 research archive, including Rounds~28--50 and subsequent
named branches, is integrated without rewriting source-pinned historical
records. The contracts paper gives a consolidated derivation of local
charged CAR fields from the original filled QWZ sea: both adjoints,
integer charge, finite-energy generator convergence and the top-edge
charge minimum $q^2/2-q/4$. Neutral four-point collision control and the
improved auxiliary-window estimate are included with their exact scope.
Neither result supplies the microscopic half-charge $E_8$ spin field.

For the separate, declared compact-$U(1)$ rotor/CAR parent, the new text
records all-electric resummation, full all-time quasi-local automorphisms,
the failure of point-norm continuity on the full bounded algebra, and
neutral physical ground-state representations. Stronger coercivity and
Wilson-loop spectral moments yield nonzero positive-energy weight, not
a mass or a many-body gap theorem. The actual Clock phase classification,
interaction provenance, eight-bit lattice cocycle refinement and
scalar-symbol Weyl obstruction identify the still missing common-parent
bridge. The sharp half-twist implementability obstruction is retained;
renormalized inter-sector fields are the next construction target.

The related double-cover, inter-sheet and prime-event investigations are
archived with their negative controls and separate arithmetic scope.
The current charged-field regression chain contains 131 tests per mode
(ordinary and optimized Python); these are execution controls, not
independent mathematical review or physical completion. Frontier,
introduction via this changelog, research overview, open-problem map,
website metadata, PDF mirrors and reproducibility instructions are
updated together. All T1--T8, TOE, empirical and RH markers are unchanged.

\subsection*{2026-09-07 (CLXI): Non-RH research through Round 27 integrated into repository, papers and website}
The previously local theory-contract archive is shipped with its proofs,
source-pinned checkers and immutable per-round validation snapshots.
The intervening geometry, positive-parent, constraint-domain and charge
transport branches retain their distinct hypotheses and additional
off-shell inputs; they are not combined into a claimed microscopic TOE.
The contracts paper now includes the full-reference argument for the
original finite-regulator $g=0$ scalar/charge model:
$e^{-48\beta NJ}Z_D\le Z\le Z_{\rm abs}\le Z_D$, retaining every charge,
the E8 cocycle and the charge-dependent scalar determinants. This removes
the artificial extra charge heat-trace factor from the sign, memory and
hop bounds, but not the extensive exponential sign budget.

For $N=27,T=3,\beta=1,J=0.1$, the certified $1\%$ omission planner improves
from $K4096/P962$ to $K2670/P354$; refining the old inequalities to the same
integer search gives $K4035/P956$. A declared weak-hopping example at
$L=9,T=33,\delta=3/4,m=a=1,J=1/866052$ certifies $R=12$: $25$ of $33$
quadratic time offsets, memory error at most $0.2045\%$, and combined
omission error below $1\%$ with $K12235/P5$. The full eliminated determinant
remains a full-history function. The partition itself is not evaluated,
and the naive history counts remain astronomical. Round 27 has two checkers
with $23/25$ exact groups and $18$ input pins each, $37$ isolated fixtures
passing normally and under optimization, and $29$ prerequisite reruns.
No T1--T8, physical TOE, empirical or RH status is promoted.

The existing correction to \texttt{v472\_quillen\_detline\_moduli.py},
its ledger description and the corresponding contract is included unchanged:
the finite result is an occupied Berry line and integrated Chern response,
not a globally nonvanishing Dai--Freed section or a continuum Quillen
connection. Its seven checks pass. Frontier prose, public research text,
document metadata, PDFs and generated mirrors are updated together.

\subsection*{2026-09-06 (CLX): QWZ zero-mode portability correction and a free 3D matter contract}
Linux reproduction exposed an eigensolver-dependent choice of a pure
zero-mode vacuum in \texttt{v1033\_charged\_disorder.py}. The numerical
diagnostic now uses the basis-independent fixed-particle ground-space mixture
and computes variational energy bounds over every pure zero-space filling.
At $N=64$ the smooth $N$-scaled mixture excess is $6.904290$, with full
ground-space interval $[5.333652,8.474929]$; the former $8.475$ value was
filling-dependent, not a unique vacuum coefficient. The charged-disorder
proof is amended explicitly. The same $35/35$ typed checks pass without
weakening an exact identity; the integration guards now report subprocess
output on failure and include a degenerate-basis regression. All $20/20$
integration tests pass in isolated Linux Python 3.11 and 3.12 environments.
The registered suite remains 1028 modules, with 233 Round-7 checks.

A separate, unpromoted theory contract in
\texttt{experiments/theory-contracts/free-scalar-3d/} supplies a finite-range
symmetric free-scalar stress on the original staggered sites, links and
plaquettes without changing the energy density or current. Its complete
real-space derivation and $68/68$ exact checks include all three momentum
Ward identities, genuine negative controls, bilinear Bloch transitions,
periodic conserved charges and the quadratic Weyl operator lift. This is
not yet a new registered verification module or a TFPT parent construction.
Interacting matter, nonlinear gravity feedback and the missing homogeneous
gravity receiver remain open. No T1--T8, TOE or RH marker moves.

\subsection*{2026-09-05 (CLIX): non-RH round 7 --- free quantum curvature, charged twists and interaction boundaries}
Five modules \texttt{v1031}--\texttt{v1035} add $233/233$ typed checks
(183 exact, 13 source-contract, 37 floating) to the registered suite
($1023\to1028$ modules), including the round-6 quantum prerequisite.
\texttt{v1031\_quantum\_tensor\_curvature.py} ($69/69$) constructs the
zero-mean Weyl/Fock target and its distribution limit;
\texttt{v1032\_covariant\_curvature.py} ($34/34$) supplies exact
identities for the positive local Lorentz-covariant free curvature field
with helicities $\pm2$. Neither derives a common microscopic TFPT parent.
\texttt{v1033\_charged\_disorder.py} ($35/35$) constructs auxiliary
$\Z_4$ flux-register corners and proves the quarter-twist mismatch
$h=1/4\ne h_\lambda=1$ and the integer-dressing parity obstruction.
\texttt{v1034\_parent\_mirror.py} ($36/36$) proves the factorized
onsite lower gap $1+\sqrt3/2$ and refutes a proposed bare-hopping
vacuum-relative form bound, not every interacting gap argument. The
newly chosen bond $3/5$ is distinguished from the source coefficient $3/10$.
\texttt{v1035\_matter\_coupling.py} ($59/59$) keeps the physical
Fourier factors in the prescribed-source Ward identities and exposes
the dynamical-source, nonlinear scalar and zero-mode limitations.
Full written proofs, five narrowly typed ledger subclaims, paper-body
citations and the public status mirrors are integrated. Source-reading
v1033/v1034 require the complete repository and are not advertised as
browser-only certificates. No T1--T8 or TOE marker moves; no RH claim.
Fourteen representative exact Wolfram checks are authored and included in
the master runner; local execution is deferred because the installed
kernel requires license activation. The last verified $116/116$ count
is unchanged; no successful independent-engine run is claimed.

\subsection*{2026-09-05 (CLVIII): non-RH round 4 --- uniform TEL-B norm and explicit T1--T8 boundaries}
Five modules graduate as \texttt{v1026}--\texttt{v1030}; the suite grows
from 1018 to 1023 modules. Their standalone checks pass $353/353$.
\texttt{v1026\_\allowbreak telb\_\allowbreak round4\_\allowbreak closure.py}
($199/199$, native python-flint 0.9.0) executes CF, DG, one-sided CROSS,
512 validated Acb eigensystems, sixteen Fourier modes, all infinite aliases
and 154 numerical regressions. With v1022/v1025 inputs it proves
$\|R_N\|_{\rm HS}<2.995906<3$ at fixed $M=1$, $N_y=8$ for all even $N\ge16$. The former finite
$1.7833$ smooth bound is withdrawn; the valid finite bound is $1.800594$.
The historical $2.11$ and sharp Bound-B $0.62$ targets are not proved.
\texttt{v1027\_\allowbreak signed\_\allowbreak det\_\allowbreak car\_\allowbreak wall.py}
($47/47$) constructs canonical DET excitations and a signed $z=1$ wall
for fixed classical gauge backgrounds, changing the flat local parent
to an additive one; there is no hard bare-mirror gap or chiral continuum claim.
\texttt{v1028\_\allowbreak gauss\_\allowbreak d4\_\allowbreak cap.py}
($36/36$) counts full $192$-mode site Gauss characters modulo five
(one site 3; cube 0 on the specified nine-irrep link truncation),
constructs a symmetric internal gap-one cap, and retains the symmetry
and Majorana selection-rule obstructions.
\texttt{v1029\_\allowbreak local\_\allowbreak tensor\_\allowbreak constraints.py}
($44/44$) gives a local two-mode radiative target only after explicit
global zero-mode removal; the unmodified periodic target is unstable.
\texttt{v1030\_\allowbreak alg2\_\allowbreak sector\_\allowbreak frame.py}
($27/27$) proves the conditional sector-connectivity/actual-word frame
bridge, with joint-adjoint and high-output tails still required.
The complete proof supplement is included in the contracts paper, with
intro/frontier/MMST, ledger, website and reproducibility surfaces synchronized.
An independent-engine representative Wolfram mirror is supplied but its
execution is unavailable locally (no kernel found); no verified Wolfram
count is increased. The static discipline census (v649) now recognizes
genuine renamed imports of the shared check function; seven regression tests
reject comment/string-only and unrelated-import false positives. Its
18-check audit and twelve deterministic replays pass without exemptions.
The 68-check v1006 battery now requires the native norm certificate together
with the explicitly open FE-GEN/ALG-EXH/MMST boundaries in the memorandum;
three document-guard regression tests reject a missing premise or the old
external-box text alone. The 31-check v1016 battery likewise replaces its
historical scalar-increment document guard by the current norm certificate
and open-boundary guard, with three negative regression tests; its numerical
thresholds are unchanged. All three regression sets run in CI. The atlas
generator removes trailing whitespace introduced by one-line truncation.
All T1--T8 and the TOE contract remain open. No RH claim.

The local exit gate stays the plain \texttt{python run\_all.py}.  Fourth, in the first sharded pass: \texttt{v649\_\allowbreak discipline\_\allowbreak audit.py} D6.1 required the git-ignored local \texttt{.lake/build} directory among its ``build artefacts'' -- a reference-machine fact, absent from every fresh checkout; the check now requires the COMMITTED build descriptors (\texttt{lakefile.lean}, \texttt{lake-manifest.json}, \texttt{lean-toolchain}) and reports the local build directory informationally (18/18; the fresh \texttt{lake build} is the Lean Proofs workflow's job). carries a median $59\%$ of the gain, rungs $2$--$5$ $72\%$,
$K_{\mathrm{half}}\in\{2..5\}$ on $63/63$; rung $2$ in closed form has

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (V) (\texttt{v550} --- the odd-sector identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T151 (the one inequality closes by rerouting off the ladder, ODD-CARRIES) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]

identity/certificate core of the discovery part T151 (\texttt{odd\_ladder\_probe.py}) --- $19$

elementary Sobolev step, to a per-mode bound \emph{linear} in $k$. Scope fence: identities,
per-instance theorems with checked hypotheses and per-window \emph{certified} inequalities ---
no fit, no $D$-exponent, no zone-uniform statement, and explicitly \emph{no statement for all
$D$} (the one open input after T151 --- the $m$-freeness of the bottom pencil ratio
$R=K_{\mathrm{bot}}/\kappa$ for the odd parity sector of a sign-changing-symbol Toeplitz
section --- stays open and typed open). Battery: $12$ frame-A windows ($n=4\ldots139$,

at $m=241$ (the certified $(1,1)$ pencil) and $m=2001$ (the $\pi$ price), and a no-go size
ladder $m=64\ldots256$; each statement carries a mutation control that must fail by
$\ge10^{-3}$.

live on the \emph{shifted} grid $\theta_k=2\pi k/N$, $N=2m{+}1$, which never contains
$\theta=0$, with $\mu^P_k=2-2\cos\theta_k$ \emph{exactly} ($2.2\times10^{-16}$; eigen-residual
$2.3\times10^{-13}$); the symbol has $f(0)=-47.6\ldots-6.3<0$ (T148's honest negative, re-read
and never re-derived) with a nonempty negative window $[0,\theta_c)$, and
$\theta_c/\theta_1=0.371$--$0.485\le0.9$ on \emph{every} window: the odd grid \emph{steps over}
the negative window --- odd-sector positivity is a grid fact, stepped over rather than

resolution: the local model is a \emph{matrix} statement, not a symbol statement (controls:
the Dirichlet corner breaks the eigenpairs at $1.0$, a one-index shift misses by
$6.5\times10^{-3}$).
\item \textbf{(2) The certified bottom ladder (T151) \mE.} $\lambda_k(A)\le S\mu^P_k$ for
$k\le8$ is certified per window by $8$ completed LDL$^{\mathsf T}$ inertia counts (Sylvester
1852; Bunch--Kaufman 1977 --- a certificate, never a sorted list), $S=1.1019$--$6.4725$: the
odd sector's bottom spectrum \emph{is} the parity-Laplacian ladder up to a printed $O(1)$
factor --- order $2$ in $k$, with no trace of $f(0)<0$ in it (the Rayleigh floor

\item \textbf{(3) The discrete Sobolev step and the $\pi$ price (T151) \mE.}
$\|\nabla\psi\|_2^2=\langle\psi,L_0\psi\rangle-\psi_{\mathrm{last}}^2$ exactly
($7.6\times10^{-15}$), $\|\nabla\psi\|_2^2\le\langle\psi,L_P\psi\rangle$, and
$\|\psi\|_\infty^2\le2\|\psi\|_2\|\nabla\psi\|_2$ on the true window modes, the parity sines
and random unit vectors --- elementary, licensed by the odd sector's virtual node
$\psi_{-1}=0$ (Hardy--Littlewood--P\'olya 1934 / Agmon 1965 the continuum address);

$|\kappa-1|=1.1\times10^{-12}$ at $m=241$) and the Sobolev per-mode price is $\pi$ to

\item \textbf{(4) The closed archimedean minimum (T151; T150's rest item 2 closed and
attained) \mE.} The archimedean lag kernel has two shape properties, checked per window and
never assumed --- $c^{\mathrm{arch}}_i<0$ for $i\ge1$ and $c^{\mathrm{arch}}_i$ non-decreasing

$\min_r\Lambda^{\mathrm{arch}}_r=c^{\mathrm{arch}}_0-c^{\mathrm{arch}}_{M-1}$ \emph{exactly}

\item \textbf{Diary, paper and website (T151, \textsc{odd-carries}).} The T151 probe
(\texttt{odd\_\allowbreak ladder\_\allowbreak probe.py}, contract \texttt{ODD.LADDER},

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-28 (II) (\texttt{v543} + \texttt{v544} --- the lumped $M$-matrix pair and the long-lag support structure promoted; prime-front diary T136/T137 + website sync; NO marker moves)}
